verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer portal lists official SDKs for JavaScript, Java and .NET, alongside API guides for building apps, so developers can build against first-party SDKs. The evidence is only a navigation-level listing, with no SDK documentation depth or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: SDK reference docs, installation and usage guides, coverage of further languages such as Python, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
